# ClickRunClaw

> ClickRunClaw is an EU-first AI automation agency building production custom agents, workflow integrations, and sovereign AI pipelines for European and international businesses. 100% async delivery with dedicated European infrastructure.

## Canonical Site
- https://clickrunclaw.com

## Key Pages
- Home: https://clickrunclaw.com/
- Privacy: https://clickrunclaw.com/privacy
- Security: https://clickrunclaw.com/security

## Agency Summary
ClickRunClaw architects, builds, and manages autonomous AI agents and automated operational workflows for European businesses. Every deployment features isolated container runtimes, dedicated EU data center hosting (Germany & Finland), zero AI model training on customer data, and optional EU-sovereign model routing for strict GDPR compliance.

## Delivery Model (100% Async - Zero Voice or Video Calls)
- Scoping: Submit structured workflow requirements via our intake system or email support@clickrunclaw.com.
- Written Proposal: Receive an architecture blueprint, fixed-scope USD pricing, and security review within 24 business hours.
- Live Interactive Sandbox: Test and iterate your custom agent in an isolated preview container before deployment.
- Production Rollout: Handed off as containerized services, webhooks, and private API integrations with zero operational friction.

## Transparent USD Pricing Packages
- Starter Agent: $799 setup + $149/month
  - Single-workflow autonomous agent
  - Dedicated EU container hosting (Germany/Finland)
  - Interactive live sandbox preview
  - Email support via support@clickrunclaw.com
- Growth Funnel: $1,799 setup + $299/month
  - Multi-step agent pipeline (intake, qualification, CRM & webhook sync)
  - Dedicated EU container infrastructure
  - Isolated database & secure secret management
  - Priority written async support
- Full AI Partner: $3,499+ setup + $599/month
  - Full-stack autonomous agent operations
  - Optional EU-sovereign LLM routing & custom open-weights
  - Custom SLA, compliance documentation & ongoing optimization

## Core Capabilities
- Custom AI Agent Development
- European Data Sovereignty (German & Finnish Data Centers)
- Isolated Container Execution
- Zero Model Training Guarantee
- Optional Sovereign LLM Routing (Mistral & EU-Hosted Models)
- CRM, Database & Webhook Automation
- Async-Only Written Delivery & Verification
